newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Aug 30.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Aug 30.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Canadian media mogul Conrad Black is believed to be preparing to sell his 25 percent stake in Australian newspaper publisher John Fairfax Holdings Ltd, The Australian newspaper said. Black's Australian stockbroker Ord Minnett is understood to be making confidential soundings of fund managers who may be prepared to buy Fairfax shares, The Australian said.

Regional publishing group Rural Press Ltd said late on Thursday that it would be more difficult to achieve profit growth in the first half of 1995/96 to June 30 than in the second half. Earlier on Thursday Rural Press reported a six percent higher net profit for 1995/96 of A$31.52 million, compared with analysts forecasts of about A$32 million. It also said on Thursday it had held discussions with a number of Asian parties about a possible publishing or radio joint venture in Asia.

Italian bank Monte Paschi di Siena said on Thursday talks were still going on with Australia Bendigo Bank Ltd for the sale of Montepaschi Australia, which has a 48 billion lire (A$40.1 million) price tag.

Office supplies retailer Corporate Express Australia Ltd said late on Thursday that it expected earnings before interest, abnormals and tax for the first half ending August 31 to be lower than a year earlier.

RGC Ltd said it has made no decision on re-opening the closed mineral sands mine in Sierra Leone operated by Sierra Rutile Co, which is 50 percent owned by RGC-controlled Consolidated Rutile Ltd. It also said on Thursday the outlook for titanium dioxide (Ti02) was mixed due to strong demand offset by a price pressure from an expansion of world production capacity. RGC earlier reported a doubling of operating profit to A$108.57 million in 1995/96.
